settings.heading_text: For brands and businesses shaping tomorrow

settings.stat_body: We build long-term relationships with producers that keep us close to what is happening on the ground. This gives us a clearer understanding of how climate is affecting food systems and how we can respond through what we grow and source.

Healthy ecosystems produce better food. By partnering with regenerative farms and supporting environmental restoration through our 1% commitment, we help strengthen the systems that sustain agriculture, biodiversity, and climate resilience.
From office kitchens to retail shelves, every product you choose shapes how the world is experienced — by your teams and the customers you serve. Those choices impact our planet and our future.

settings.content: Whether you're stocking your office, procuring gifts for clients, or introducing new products to your customers, we're here to ensure your choices leave a lighter footprint on our planet. Because what we serve internally, to what we gift clients and place on shelves for others to discover reflect what we value and shape our collective future.

settings.stat_body: We work directly with producers because understanding begins with proximity. By building long-term relationships at origin, we gain a deeper understanding of the people, landscapes, and agricultural practices behind every ingredient we source.

Healthy ecosystems grow healthier food. By partnering with regenerative producers and supporting environmental restoration through our 1% commitment, we're helping build a more resilient future for agriculture, biodiversity, and the communities that depend on them.
Whether you're stocking the office kitchen, welcoming new employees, or sourcing corporate gifts for clients, every purchase becomes an opportunity to reflect the values your organisation stands for.

settings.content:
The products we bring into our workplace reflect what we value. From the coffee shared over office meetings to the gifts we give clients and colleagues, everyday choices shape our future.

At Omawild, we partner with producers restoring the landscapes we all depend on. Every product is thoughtfully sourced from farms embracing regenerative and responsible agricultural practices, while at least 1% of our annual sales supports environmental organisations working to restore ecosystems around the world.

Whether you're looking for coffee, client gifts, or employee welcome packs, we're here to help every purchase leave a lighter footprint on our home planet.
